validation_status: All 20 unified8-v1 single-card cases accepted: five methods, BF16/INT8, 1344x768,124/345 native frames, eight actual forwards at seed7. Each case passed audited warmup, further warmup, one uninstrumented formal request, a separate eight-forward profile and video/audio checks. This does not qualify every parallel or conditioning configuration.

int8_primitive_gpu_validation: Passed three shapes, including H3 QKV and the 96768-output projection, against quantized FP32 GEMM/dequantization references; all tested BF16 outputs were bitwise equal. This is not BF16-model equivalence or complete INT8 video qualification.
